mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Catch Jinx in Caitlyn's <spellName>Yordle Snap Trap</spellname> and slay her within 5 seconds.

Jinx could no longer evade Caitlyn's hunt.

“Well, you caught me. Bet that makes everything better, right?”

Slain enemies drop a Yordle Snap Trap.

“Finally, we can put all this pain behind us…”
Catch Jinx in Caitlyn's <spellName>Yordle Snap Trap</spellname> and slay her within 5 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Caitlyn fires a net, pushing her backwards. The net <status>Slows</status> the first target hit by @Effect3Amount@% for @Effect2Amount@ second and deals <magicDamage>@NetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Every @AttacksPerHeadshot@ Attacks, Caitlyn fires a Headshot. Attacks while in brush count as @BrushAttackTotal@ for building towards a Headshot.

Headshots deal an additional @HeadShotBonusDamage@ physical damage. They have double range against enemies affected by {{Spell_CaitlynEntrapment_Name}} and {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}}. Headshots against enemies hit by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} deal a further @spell.CaitlynW:HeadshotBonusDamage@ physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_CaitlynP_Tooltip}}

Headshot damage scales with level, Critical Strike Chance, and Critical Strike Damage.
Headshots deal an additional @HeadShotMinionBonusDamage@ physical damage to non-champions.
Extra damage on trapped targets scales with {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} rank.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Headshot: Count</titleLeft><mainText>Caitlyn is charging up for a headshot.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Headshot: Ready</titleLeft><mainText>Caitlyn's next basic attack will deal massive damage. Boom.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Caitlyn revs her rifle to fire a piercing shot dealing @InitialDamage@ physical damage. After the bolt strikes the first target, it opens into a wider shot that deals @SecondaryDamage@ physical damage.

Enemies revealed by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} always take full damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ace in the Hole: Targeted</titleLeft><mainText>You are about to be shot by Caitlyn.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing @RTotalDamage@ physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel.

Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Yordle Trap</titleLeft><mainText>Trapped! This unit cannot move and Caitlyn can line up a long range Headshot on it.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Elements.nameOverride: Bonus Headshot Damage on Trapped Targets

mLocKeys.keySummary: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for @RootDuration@ seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds. Traps last for @TrapDuration@ seconds, and @MaximumTraps@ traps may be active at once. This Ability has @MaximumCharges@ charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Targets rooted by this Ability take an additional @HeadshotBonusDamage@ physical damage from Headshot.
